spec: Standalone WordHunt contract: no ETH in, no payable functions, no receive, no approvals. A setter role held by the Safe (or a keeper it names) opens a round by posting keccak256 of a lowercase word and a round length in blocks. Players call commitGuess(bytes32 h) with h = keccak256(guess, ), then revealGuess(string guess) in a later block; one open commit per address per round. A reveal whose keccak256(guess) matches the word hash wins; the first such reveal is stored as the round winner, a Win event is emitted, and a per-address win counter serves as a leaderboard. A round with no winner closes empty. Only the Safe can pause. Tests: fuzz commit-reveal ordering, a copied reveal from another address fails, duplicate commit reverts, paused round rejects guesses. (a game build)
